text: Seven women will take hold of one man [1]on that day, saying:"We will eat our own foodand wear our own clothing;Only let your name be given us,put an end to our disgrace!"
t[2] On that day,The branch [3] of the Lord will be beauty and glory,and the fruit of the land will be honor and splendorfor the survivors of Israel.
Everyone who remains in Zion,everyone left in JerusalemWill be called holy:everyone inscribed for life [4] in Jerusalem. [AA]
When the Lord washes awaythe filth of the daughters of Zion,And purges Jerusalem's blood from her midstwith a blast of judgment, a searing blast, [AB]
Then will the Lord create,over the whole site of Mount Zionand over her place of assembly,A smoking cloud by dayand a light of flaming fire by night. [AC]
For over all, his glory will be shelter and protection:shade from the parching heat of day,refuge and cover from storm and rain. [AD]
